notes.title: MULTIPLAYER
notes.content:
Multiplayer has finally arrived and is fully playable! You can try guys playing with your friends on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646785/6494c2e37cc91e52f7c52ada4ea0dfa67dbeed2a.png[/img]

MULTIPLAYER FEATURES:
- full steam integration showing friends, avatars, allowing for invites and join
- hosting and searching for public servers
- Steam Presence tell you if your friends are playing, are in lobby or the main menu
- lobby functionality, chat, kick, ready, countdown
- multiplayer savegame system allowing to save and create a new game from the savegame

GAME MECHANICS ADAPTED FOR MULTIPLAYER:
- grid mechanics - construction, destruction, rotation, turning devices off, recycling
- separate technology tree for each player
- shared technology points
- third person characters look with new animations
- characters movement, position, tools are replicated and saved
- water networks
- electric networks
- conveyor and resource movement
- AI and movement
- asteroids - are fully replicated - players know when asteroids are hit and destroyed
- interaction - asteroid catcher, harpoon, docking systems
- voxels - adding and removing
- Vehicles and more!

notes.title: Drills, windows stay open, recyclables used for construction!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646785/e57d025351389bc271193dabca130d08ccf8966f.png[/img]

In this update drills are added to Astro Colony. It's a new exciting way of extracting resources from the ground!
Use them to mine Quartz, Stone or any other resource!

Meanwhile we are experimenting with balance and tech tree changes.
For example Chemistry is now required to reaseach Advanced Mining (Miners). It creates a need of having Astronauts sooner!

Opened menus from devices and inventory (like crafting) will stay open and remember it's state.

You can now destroy devices and use recyclables back to construct them again!

In addition many fixes and small QOL improvements:
[list]
[*] Each device by default has maximum workers assigned
[*] Fixed issue with multiple drones assigned to the workplace at the same time
[*] Fixed issue with surface details (planet foliage) not being generated or generated in wrong places (other space station)
[*] Fixed some visuals not updated after device rotation
[*] Fixed crafting issue, where saving was pushing progress by few %
[*] Docking station easier to construct on the planet - clear space in front when constructed
[/list]

tags.feature: In this update drills are added to Astro Colony.
Opened menus from devices and inventory (like crafting) will stay open and remember it's state.
You can now destroy devices and use recyclables back to construct them again!

notes.title: Transport bots can now transport absolutely anything!
notes.content:
In this update Transport Bots system was upgraded to the state, where each device can create their own requests for resources. Bots will figure out and balance resources in your network!

Bug fixes:
- Fixed space station selection, so more starting stations can be picked
- Fixed recent tech tree problems
- Holograms are better visible
- Conveyor belts improved with new speed for ramps
- Transport bots are now able to transport all resources from any device like (Farm, Mine or Canteen)

notes.title: Logic Signals
notes.content:
The update adds a system of logical blocks and the ability to turn off each device separately.
The sensor recognizes the inventory state and sends the appropriate signal.
An arithmetic block can process this signal. Logic decider controls the state of the devices.

Additionally, numerous minor improvements and fixes:
[list]
[*] Logic Signals: Signal cable, Sensor, Arithmetic, Decider, 
[*] Version system capable of converting savegames between versions
[*] Fixes: energy transmitter/receiver, astronauts and other
[*] New metahumans
[*] Optimized gameplay and the game size
[/list]
